title: FoulEvent
description: One record per foul call. Central entity of the referee tracking system. All fields come directly from NBA CDN endpoints — no text parsing required.

game_id.description: NBA game identifier (e.g. '0042500164'). Prefix '004' = playoffs, '25' = 2024-25 season.

action_number.description: Unique event identifier within a game. API field: actionNumber.

period.description: Game period. 1-4 for regulation, 5+ for overtime.

clock.description: Time remaining in the period (e.g. 'PT09M56.00S'). API field: clock.

foul_type.description: Action type from the API. Always 'foul' for this schema. API field: actionType.

foul_subtype.description: Foul subtype from the API. API field: subType. Known values: 'personal', 'technical'.

fouler_player_id.description: Player ID of the player who committed the foul. Tracks fouls committed. API field: personId.

fouler_player_name.description: Abbreviated name of the player who committed the foul (e.g. 'A. Dosunmu'). API field: playerNameI.

fouler_team_id.description: Team ID of the player who committed the foul. API field: teamId.

fouler_team_tricode.description: Three-letter team code of the fouler (e.g. 'MIN'). API field: teamTricode.

fouled_player_id.description: Player ID of the player who was fouled. Tracks fouls drawn. API field: foulDrawnPersonId. Null for technical fouls (no specific player fouled).

fouled_player_name.description: Last name of the player who was fouled (e.g. 'Murray'). API field: foulDrawnPlayerName. Null for technical fouls.

official_id.description: ID of the referee who called the foul. API field: officialId. Resolved to official_name via the game boxscore officials list.

official_name.description: Full name of the referee who called the foul (e.g. 'Pat Fraher'). Resolved by matching official_id against boxscore officials for the game.

foul_personal_total.description: Running personal foul total for the fouling player at the time of this call. API field: foulPersonalTotal.

foul_detail.description: Granular foul category parsed from description. Values: 'shooting', 'loose_ball', 'flagrant_1', 'flagrant_2', 'offensive', 'personal', 'technical'. Use foul_detail != 'technical' to get total non-technical fouls.

description.description: Play description from the API (e.g. 'A. Dosunmu personal FOUL (1 PF)'). Kept for reference. API field: description.
